featured_reviews.name: Poornima Kotian
featured_reviews.review_text:
Grateful Beyond Words
I am Purnima Kotian, mother of Siddharth Bhaskar Kotian, a 19-year-old deaf special child. For nearly one year, I kept taking my son to Nair Hospital, but sadly, we were continuously refused proper treatment because of his condition. As a mother, it was heartbreaking to see my child in pain and not receive the care he deserved.
We were then guided to Snehal E.N.T. Clinic and Sinus Centre at borivali west, and meeting Dr. Smeet Vadher changed everything for us. From the very first consultation, he treated my son with patience, compassion, and dignity. He took the time to understand Siddharth’s condition and made us feel confident and hopeful.
Both the ENT specialist and neurologist were consulted, and they assured us that everything would go well. We were clearly explained about the Septoplasty plus turbinate reduction surgery and were promised relief from his nose joint pain, headaches, and breathing difficulties.
By God’s grace and the expertise of Dr. Smeet Vadher and his team, the surgery was successful. My son is now relieved from the pain and discomfort he had been suffering from for so long.
I will always be grateful to Snehal E.N.T. Clinic and Sinus Centre for giving my son the care, respect, and treatment he needed. I strongly recommend this clinic to anyone looking for genuine and compassionate medical care, especially for special children.
🙏
— Purnima Kotian and Siddharth Kotian, Lower parel west
